decision: Separate prelaunch ldd probe, mandatory LDD_VERIFIER callback and full OS-library authentication are not original E137 requirements. Replace the self-imposed gate with an independently reviewed deterministic startup policy, not a synthetic PASS.
source_fact: Pinned helper may prepend a width-specific vendor library path or replace LD_LIBRARY_PATH by that directory. Persistent LDD diagnostic prints an error but does not itself stop engine invocation.
policy: Exact pinned source chain and observed finite selected-engine metadata, fixed root/platform/arguments and controlled initial profile
Reject injection, debug, prologue and unknown paths or behavior
Permit only source-derived vendor-width prefix or single-vendor-directory replacement
Invoke unchanged vendor launcher at most once under original resource/process supervision; no extra exploratory LDD or tool probe
Preserve and reject startup errors, unresolved warnings or observation loss as terminal scientific failure; no retry
Do not promise zero engine invocation after a vendor diagnostic or claim final environment observed without evidence
